title: Contemplative Living in Today's World
location: Dominican Center, 1700 Fulton St. E, Grand Rapids, MI
description: Join us one Sunday each month for a welcoming community for those seeking to cultivate a more contemplative spiritual life. Together, we will explore contemplative practices, the wisdom of the Christian mystical tradition, sacred conversation, silence, and reflection to recognize God's presence within ourselves, within one another, and throughout all creation.
